# Support

Downshift by Tiago Vilas Boas — https://github.com/tiagovilasboas/downshift-ai

## Where to go

- **Questions, ideas, and setup help:** [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/tiagovilasboas/downshift-ai/discussions)
- **Bug reports and misroutes:** [Open an issue](https://github.com/tiagovilasboas/downshift-ai/issues/new/choose) using the matching template (`misroute`, `new-harness`, `plan-compatibility`, or `stats-export`). Run `downshift doctor --verbose` first when reporting hook or setup problems.
- **Pilot / 1-week external telemetry:** Share a prompt-free `downshift export --days=7` output via the `pilot-report` or `stats-export` issue templates ([operator guide](../docs/guides/operator.md), [beta exit criteria](../docs/reference/beta-exit.md)).
- **Security vulnerabilities:** Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and report privately via [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/tiagovilasboas/downshift-ai/security/advisories/new). Never post tokens, transcripts, or secrets in public issues.
